answer: Retroactive correlation scoring: each identity's transactions form a behavioral trace scored against a fitted onyx baseline of established agents. Agents whose traces cluster tightly in timing, amount, and counterparty patterns get merged and their rewards clawed back. A trellis of independent corroborating traces is required to split identities. An attacker must sustain months of natural-looking nectar-level activity per fake identity, paying real fees and risk before detection.
